summary: Iteration 34 - Verified all 5 backend features requested: (1) Accounting Excel export returns valid xlsx (PK zip header, openxml content-type) and accepts optional category query param. (2) Accounting /report returns new category_breakdown (list of {category,count,amount}) and available_categories fields; category filter correctly restricts transactions. (3) Plan CRUD now persists optional category field (default General) via POST, GET and PUT. (4) Open-turnstile command allowed for gym_admin on own gym device while reboot still restricted to super_admin. (5) Member /me endpoint returns fresh JWT token for silent refresh. 11/11 pytest tests passed against http://localhost:8001.
critical_code_review_comments: accounting_routes.py is >700 lines (898) - consider splitting PDF/Excel generators into separate modules for maintainability.

In /accounting/report when admin is super_admin and no gym_id provided, plan_cat_map is built from ALL plans (plan_query={}) - correct behavior, but category filtering across gyms could cross-contaminate if two plans share a name but different categories. Acceptable for current scope.
device_management_routes.send_device_command correctly enforces maintenance_cmds (super_admin only) vs gym_cmds (own-gym gym_admin). Good separation.
/auth/member/login uses `code` as query param (not JSON body) - works but is unusual REST style; keep documented for frontend consumers.
Plan PUT allowed_fields now includes 'category' as expected; nothing else leaks.
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_ prefixed plan with category=Kickboxing (then updated to Boxeo) and a TEST_ prefixed gym_admin user per run. No cleanup teardown implemented - test data uses TEST_ prefix for easy identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 iteration-34 backend features verified at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration34_backend.py. Member login uses query param ?code=XXX (not JSON). To re-run: pytest backend/tests/test_iteration34_backend.py -v.
